title: Sikkim Congress and locals protest appointment of Governor Dushyant Gautam in Gangtok
seoTitle: Gangtok protest against Governor Dushyant Gautam

tea.why: Protesters oppose the appointment of Dushyant Gautam as Sikkim Governor due to allegations linking him to the 2022 Ankita Bhandari case.
tea.want: They demand that the Centre revoke or defer Gautam's appointment until the CBI completes its investigation into the murder case.
tea.changed: Oct 18: Demonstrators continued their opposition in Gangtok ahead of the scheduled October 19 swearing-in ceremony.

summary: Opposition parties, students, and locals staged protests in Gangtok, Sikkim, to voice their strong opposition to the appointment of senior BJP leader Dushyant Kumar Gautam as the state governor. The Sikkim Pradesh Congress Committee organized a protest at the district court premises, while students and citizens gathered at the District Administrative Centre. Demonstrators expressed outrage over allegations that Gautam is the unnamed 'VIP' involved in the 2022 murder case of receptionist Ankita Bhandari, which is currently being investigated by the Central Bureau of Investigation. Protesters demanded that his gubernatorial assignment be recalled or put on hold until the CBI inquiry is fully concluded and a clean chit is issued. Organizers emphasized that the citizen-led demonstrations were peaceful and warned that opposition would persist despite the upcoming swearing-in.
demands: Cancel or defer the appointment of Dushyant Gautam as Sikkim Governor
Wait until the CBI investigation into the Ankita Bhandari case concludes
Address the concerns raised by Bhandari's parents
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: The Sikkim Pradesh Congress Committee staged a protest at the district court premises in Gangtok demanding Gautam's recall.
Students and locals held a protest at the District Administrative Centre in Gangtok opposing the gubernatorial appointment.
